depiction.primary_object: open-topped rectangle box with an upward-pointing arrow exiting the top
modifiers: upward arrow emerging from top gap

readings.meaning: share or send out (iOS share sheet icon)
upload file to server or cloud

ambiguity: Can be confused with a pure 'upload' icon (typically a shallow tray with an up arrow or a cloud with an up arrow), whereas this enclosing box with a top gap is the standard Apple 'share / export' glyph.

modifier_semantics.meaning: exporting, sending out, sharing, or uploading outward from a local source

task_intents: export data or records to file
share link or album with others
back up local files to cloud

reasoning: Shows an upward arrow exiting the top of an open box, universally recognized as the 'share', 'export', or 'upload' action icon. While originally a UI action glyph, exporting data, uploading forms to portals, and sharing links or files are very common concrete action-centered tasks where the verb is the core intent.
